text: Some Chinese rare-earth suppliers stopped shipments to U.S. customers amid geopolitical concerns, tightening access to critical materials used in aerospace and semiconductor manufacturing.
Hungary announced stronger environmental oversight of EV battery plants, including substantially higher pollution penalties and a new authority monitoring battery manufacturing and recycling.
A major earthquake in Taiwan disrupted TSMC operations and caused production-related losses, although the company reported no structural damage to its fabrication plants.
The United States removed TSMC's fast-track authorization for shipments of U.S.-origin chipmaking equipment to its Nanjing facility, requiring individual export licenses for future shipments.
review_note: Export restriction targets access to advanced semiconductor manufacturing equipment; classified as TECHNOLOGY_EMBARGO under the labeling guide.

text: The United States announced higher tariffs on Chinese semiconductors, electric vehicle batteries, battery components and critical minerals as part of changes to its import policy.
